fieldData.corps:
At Work & Share, our flexible office, coworking and event spaces are not just places to work. They are real living spaces, where conversations, encounters and conviviality set the pace of everyday life. And if this unique atmosphere exists, it is largely thanks to an outstanding team: our Coworking Managers.

Always there, always ready to listen, they look after our residents’ wellbeing, make their day-to-day run smoothly and build a true community. But do you really know what their role involves and everything they do to make our spaces so pleasant?

Ambassadors of conviviality

As soon as you walk through the door of a Work & Share space, they are the ones who greet you with a smile. Their mission? To make every resident feel at home from day one. A word of welcome, a shared coffee, a story swapped… All these little touches create a warm and caring atmosphere.

Our Coworking Managers orchestrate life together: they encourage conversations, spark encounters and bring that friendly energy that makes all the difference.

Guardians of smooth running

Every day, our Coworking Managers make sure everything runs like clockwork. Room bookings, office management, rapid response to technical issues, welcoming new residents… Their goal is simple: to give our community a work environment where everything is designed around them.

Have a specific request? An urgent need? They are there, responsive and always ready to find a solution.

Creators of experiences and unforgettable moments

At Work & Share, we believe a flexible office space is not just a place to put down your laptop. It is a place where people share, talk and build connections. And our Coworking Managers understand that perfectly!

They are the ones who come up with and organise a whole range of events to bring the community to life:

🍳 Friendly breakfasts to start the day right

🍹 Festive afterworks to unwind after work

🎤 Inspiring talks to learn and grow

🧘‍♀️ Wellbeing workshops to take care of yourself

And much more!

These shared moments aim to turn our spaces into truly vibrant communities.

Customer satisfaction experts

Our Coworking Managers are true service perfectionists. Nothing escapes them: from the Wi-Fi working properly to the quality of the coffee, the atmosphere of the spaces and smooth bookings. Their mission? To make sure every detail contributes to a seamless, pleasant experience, by highlighting our offers and services so they best meet our residents’ needs.

But their role doesn’t stop there. Always listening, they gather residents’ feedback, identify what can be improved and pass on suggestions to constantly enrich the Work & Share experience. Every comment counts, every idea is considered, because our ambition is simple: to make our spaces evolve with and for our community.

Much more than managers: pillars of Work & Share

Our Coworking Managers are not just organisers or everyday facilitators. They embody the Work & Share spirit every day: kindness, conviviality and a family spirit.

Thanks to their commitment and passion, our spaces come to life and become much more than places to work: they are true professional havens, where people enjoy coming every day — to work, of course, but also to talk, laugh, share and grow together.

So next time you bump into one of our Coworking Managers in our spaces, don’t hesitate to say hello, share a coffee or ask them a question!

fieldData.corps:
Work & Share is an independent, family-run operator specialising in flexible offices in Île-de-France. Work & Share also designs event venues for businesses and provides hospitality services in office buildings (reception and community management, concierge, management of shared spaces…).

A family adventure

The Work & Share adventure began in 2016, as a family affair, when Matthieu and Emmanuel Russel founded the company together with Adrien Le Roy, a childhood friend.

The 3 co-founders set out to build a network of flexible office spaces in Paris’s inner and outer suburbs, in areas easily reached by public transport and in neighbourhoods with a strong business presence.

Work & Share opened its first space in Clichy in 2017, marking the start of a bold ambition: to offer flexible, competitive work solutions for companies in Île-de-France.

Work & Share champions a convivial vision of coworking. Through its concept “The guesthouse for entrepreneurs”, the company creates workspaces that feel like home, breaking with the traditional codes of the office. Work & Share builds warm, community-focused work environments where clients can collaborate, connect and thrive.

The company recruits Coworking Managers, the true hosts of its spaces, with hospitality backgrounds and a genuine passion for welcoming people, service and customer relations.

Work & Share spaces are designed for a wide range of professionals: sole traders, freelancers, small and medium-sized businesses, and project teams from large corporations.

The impact of the Covid-19 pandemic

In 2020, Work & Share opened its second space, in Rueil-Malmaison right by the RER A, in a standalone building of more than 3,000 m². After the first Covid-19 lockdown, demand poured in and the company decided to speed up its growth in Île-de-France.

Covid-19 accelerated companies’ need for flexibility and agility.

Gradually, a growing number of small and medium-sized businesses turned to flex office operators to make their real estate more flexible. Many companies now choose flexible offices to be closer to where their people live, and introduce remote-working policies for their employees. Companies have less visibility on their business and can no longer commit to long leases and fixed floor areas. Large corporations also increasingly use flex office spaces to house project teams and outsource real estate management.

The era of new ways of working

From 2021 to 2024, Work & Share accelerated its growth by opening 10 new spaces in Île-de-France, in the Hauts-de-Seine (92) and Seine-Saint-Denis (93).

2024 marked a major milestone for the company, with the opening of its first two projects within Paris itself, in the 12th and 18th arrondissements.

Also in 2024, Work & Share won the tender to manage the Business Center of the Eos building, in Issy-les-Moulineaux, home to Microsoft’s French headquarters.

At the same time, Work & Share is developing a hospitality business for landlords, managing and animating building lobbies and shared spaces.

By the end of 2024, Work & Share had built a network of around 30,000 m² across 15 spaces in Île-de-France. The company employs nearly 50 people.

Our values

Work & Share’s values are deeply rooted in the history and spirit of its 3 co-founders.

Family spirit is at the heart of the company, founded by Matthieu, Emmanuel and Adrien, who share a common vision of teamwork. This family spirit is reflected in their management approach, where collaboration, trust and mutual respect are essential pillars. Being a family business gives the company a structure in which everyone feels valued and supported — employees, clients and partners alike.

Kindness and tolerance are core values that guide how they manage professional relationships. At Work & Share, active listening and inclusion are priorities. The co-founders have created a culture where every individual is treated with respect and empathy. This translates into strong team cohesion, a positive working atmosphere and a lasting commitment to their clients.

Sharing is another pillar of Work & Share. At Work & Share, people share ideas, knowledge and experience. The company stands out for its ability to create professional communities where exchange is encouraged. The 3 co-founders firmly believe that success is amplified when it is shared, which is at the heart of their mission to foster a dynamic, collaborative entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Finally, conviviality is one of Work & Share’s hallmarks. The company strives to create warm, welcoming, human-scale workspaces where professional interactions happen naturally. Their unique approach to hospitality in coworking spaces and event venues reflects a desire to make the work experience as enjoyable and rewarding as possible for all their residents.

Privacy and comfort: go for a private office

Want a space entirely dedicated to you and your team? Our private office offer is ideal.

You’ll find fully equipped private offices that you can lay out as you wish (desks, chairs, storage). To make moving in easy, these offices are wired, have dual-flow air conditioning (heating and cooling) and very high-speed Wi-Fi (1 Gb, private fibre).

For maximum flexibility, our Work & Share space is open 24/7 and cleaned every day. We also take care of your mail.

Renting a private office in one of our flexible office and coworking spaces gives you a number of black-and-white and colour prints included in your contract, as well as access to our meeting rooms and creative spaces through a credit system.

On the community side, joining a Work & Share space means joining a warm and friendly community of residents, with whom you’ll have the chance to connect every day, especially at the community events organised by our Coworking Managers.

You’ll also run into them every day in the shared areas of our spaces, which you all have access to: the Bistrot corner, relaxation and social areas, gardens and terraces.

Energy and flexibility: discover the hot-desk offer

Are you self-employed and looking for an accessible flex office solution in a lively environment? Our hot-desk offer is made for you!

Enjoy a desk in an open-plan space, with access Monday to Friday, 9 am to 7 pm.

Unlimited plan, 10 days per month, or a pack of 10 working days to use over 6 months: choose the option that best suits your professional needs.

This offer includes access to the space’s high-speed Wi-Fi, as well as to our shared areas and our community events.

The best of both worlds: choose the dedicated offer

A good compromise between the hot-desk offer and a fully private office, our dedicated offer gives you a fixed desk in a closed office shared with other members of the Work & Share community.

As with private office contracts, our dedicated offer gives you access to our space 24/7, three hours of meeting rooms per month, prints included in your contract, and access to our shared areas and the events we organise for our community.

Your own space within one of ours: the managed office

We have recently launched a new managed office offer, perfect for fast-growing companies looking for a space entirely their own, without the constraints of a traditional lease.

This solution gives you a workspace of up to 300 m², including a kitchenette, private offices and meeting rooms, just for you and your team!

Why choose Work & Share?

Our offers stand out from traditional office rentals because they are turnkey, with no extra costs.

All services, such as electricity, internet, cleaning… are included in your contract. On average, our clients save 30% compared with a traditional lease.

What’s more, at Work & Share the security deposit is reduced to just two months’ rent excl. VAT, compared with the three to six months required by a traditional lease.

As for fit-out work, you no longer need to worry about it. Our offices come fully equipped, saving you between €200 and €500 per m² depending on the work usually needed to set up a new office.

By choosing Work & Share, you opt for a flexible, cost-effective, tailor-made solution for you and your team!

fieldData.extrait: Traditionally seen as a model reserved for start-ups and freelancers, coworking also proves very beneficial for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).

image-principale.alt: What are the benefits of coworking for SMEs?

fieldData.corps:
Long associated with start-ups and freelancers, coworking also offers real advantages for SMEs.

According to a recent survey by Asterès and the Flex Office Think Tank, more than 80% of coworkers are employees, and 75% of them, excluding the self-employed, work for SMEs with fewer than 250 employees.

This trend highlights the growing importance of coworking as a workplace solution for SMEs.

Flexibility and lower costs

One of the main benefits of coworking for SMEs is the flexibility it offers.

Unlike traditional commercial leases, which are often rigid, coworking lets companies easily adjust the size of their offices as they grow. For example, an expanding SME can start with a small space and, as it develops, move to a larger office without the constraints of a traditional lease.

At Work & Share, private office contracts are scalable, so desks can be added at any time if the company grows. This flexibility helps reduce the financial risks of running a traditional office, in particular by avoiding real estate operating costs such as services and maintenance.

What’s more, Work & Share residents pay a single invoice that covers not only the office but also Wi-Fi, cleaning and access to shared services. This simplifies financial management and helps companies keep better control of their spending.

Attractiveness and recruitment

In a competitive job market, attracting top talent is essential to an SME’s success. A modern, inspiring coworking space can play a key role in recruitment. Employers who offer a pleasant, stimulating work environment stand out, which helps them win over potential candidates.

Work & Share offers a work environment that fosters creativity and innovation, with relaxation areas and well-equipped meeting rooms. This warm, friendly atmosphere helps create a place where employees feel good, which is crucial for companies looking to attract and retain talent.

Impact on productivity and wellbeing

The benefits of coworking go beyond attractiveness and cost. Several studies have shown that employee wellbeing in a coworking space has a direct impact on productivity. According to the Asterès survey, productivity gains in these environments are estimated at around €11,000 per year per coworker.

Work & Share spaces are designed to be welcoming, with relaxation zones and collaborative workspaces. This attention to the work environment helps create a positive atmosphere, helping employees give their best.

Opportunities to socialise and network

Another key aspect of coworking is the opportunity to socialise and network. Coworking spaces bring together professionals from many sectors, creating opportunities for exchange and collaboration. These interactions foster new ideas and strengthen the culture of innovation within SMEs.

At Work & Share, the resident community includes more than 300 companies of all sizes and sectors. Events held in the spaces, such as workshops or breakfasts, also provide opportunities to meet. These moments let professionals share their experiences, learn from one another and build synergies that benefit their businesses.

Conclusion

In short, coworking is an effective and attractive solution for SMEs. It offers flexibility, cost savings and improved employee wellbeing. Work & Share spaces are designed to meet the varied needs of companies, providing a work environment suited to both individual productivity and collaboration.

If you’d like to learn more about Work & Share’s coworking and flexible office offers and find out how coworking can benefit your company, feel free to contact us!

fieldData.extrait: When the office becomes an HR strategy tool: what companies have understood. This principle — the workspace as a lever of people strategy — is one of the most profound changes…

image-principale.alt: Flexible offices and HR: the workspace as a strategic tool

fieldData.corps:
This principle — the workspace as a lever of people strategy — is one of the most profound changes the business world has gone through in recent years. And it is far from fully absorbed.

The workspace is no longer a cost item, it is a signal.

What your offices say about you before the interview even starts

When a candidate arrives for an interview, they observe. The reception, the light, the noise level, how teams interact in the space. Within minutes, they form an image of the company that no recruiter’s pitch can change.

Dull, poorly equipped, soulless offices send a signal: here, people are not a priority. Well-designed, pleasant, functional spaces say the opposite.

In a market where talent has a choice, that signal matters.

Quality of life at work is not just a management issue

The research is clear: employees who work in a well-designed environment are more productive, less stressed and more likely to stay with the company.

Natural light, acoustics, social spaces, the ability to find privacy or collaborate as needed all directly influence wellbeing and performance.

The three HR levers of flexible real estate

1. Appeal to candidates

New generations of talent pay particular attention to the work environment. They grew up in spaces that value design, comfort and functionality. An office that looks like a modern workspace is a genuine recruitment asset.

Flexible real estate lets companies that can’t afford to build a Google-style campus offer a premium environment. In a high-quality managed space, every tenant enjoys a level of finish and service that would be out of reach if they managed it themselves.

2. Retention through operational comfort

Everyday friction builds up fatigue. A badge that doesn’t work, a broken printer, a meeting room that’s never free, weak coffee. These small irritations seem trivial one by one. Accumulated over weeks, they erode the sense of belonging.

In a well-run space, these frictions don’t exist. The space works. Services are available. Teams can focus on their work without dealing with facilities.

This operational comfort is an underestimated retention factor.

3. Flexibility as a competitive advantage

The war for talent is also fought on working conditions. A company that can offer its people several workspaces — a main office, the option to work from a coworking space near home, meeting rooms available on demand — provides a flexibility that builds loyalty.

That is what operators like Work & Share make possible: not just a main space, but a network of spaces that adapts to teams’ lifestyles.

What this means in practice for HR directors

Make real estate part of your employer brand strategy

Employer branding isn’t limited to financial benefits or leave policies. It covers the day-to-day experience at the office. HR directors who understand this work hand in hand with real estate teams to make the workplace a differentiating asset.

In practice, this can mean: showcasing workspaces on recruitment social media, including an office tour in the onboarding process, involving employees in layout decisions.

Test before you commit

One of the advantages of flexible real estate is that you can try before committing. Before signing a long lease for a new space, you can organise working days in the shortlisted space — to check that teams feel at home there, that the commute works and that the atmosphere matches the company culture.

This trial avoids unpleasant surprises and gives real estate decisions legitimacy with teams.

Think network rather than single head office

The single head office model increasingly belongs to the past. Companies that build a network of spaces — main head office, local branches, coworking points — offer a geographical flexibility that matches employees’ lifestyles today.

For HR, it is a tool to reduce relocations linked to internal mobility, widen the recruitment pool and meet the expectations of employees who no longer want to endure long daily commutes.

fieldData.corps:
The office real estate market in Île-de-France saw a notable shift in the first quarter of 2024, with immediately available supply continuing to grow and exceeding 4.5 million m². This unprecedented situation reveals contrasting dynamics between the region’s sub-markets.

A two-speed market: central Paris and Neuilly vs. the Paris suburbs

Two distinct segments clearly emerge:

Central Paris and Neuilly: These areas are very dynamic, with extremely low vacancy rates (2% in the Central Business District, <4% in Neuilly). Transaction volume rose by 50% between Q1 2023 and Q1 2024, showing sustained demand despite limited supply. Available properties in these markets turn over quickly, often within a few months.

Inner and outer Paris suburbs: These areas, notably the northern inner suburbs (Saint-Ouen, Saint-Denis, Aubervilliers, Pantin) and the Greater La Défense area (Puteaux, Courbevoie, Nanterre, Rueil, Colombes), suffer from oversupply. With high vacancy rates of 20% and 19% respectively, these markets have seen transaction volumes fall — by 20% in the inner suburbs and 60% in the outer suburbs between Q1 2023 and Q1 2024. La Défense itself, despite vacancy falling to 14%, saw transactions drop by 50% over the same period.

The southern inner suburbs, including towns such as Montrouge, Ivry, Arcueil, Bagneux and Châtillon, also saw vacancy rise, reaching 14% in Q1 2024 against a regional average of 8%.

These figures, from Cushman & Wakefield’s Marketbeat report for Q1 2024, illustrate the challenges facing the office real estate market in Île-de-France.

fieldData.chapeau: For decades, the number one criterion when choosing offices in Île-de-France was the address. Paris 8th, Paris 15th, La Défense. The postcode built the reputation, justified the rent and reassured clients.
fieldData.extrait: For decades, the number one criterion when choosing offices in Île-de-France was the address. Paris 8th, Paris 15th, La Défense. The postcode built the reputation, justified the rent…

image-principale.alt: Offices in Île-de-France: accessibility matters more than the address

fieldData.corps:
That paradigm is starting to crack.

What we see today, at Work & Share and across the flex real estate market more broadly, is a shift in the deciding criterion. Business leaders and HR directors looking for offices no longer ask “which arrondissement?”. They ask: “how long will it take my people to get there?”

The right address is the right line. Not the right postcode.

The end of geographical prestige as the ultimate criterion

When the 8th is no longer worth the asking price

The office market within Paris remains tight. Rents in central districts are still at levels that force companies to cut back on space, multiply shared desks and squeeze teams.

The result: workspaces that don’t really work. Crowded open-plan offices where concentration is impossible. Meeting rooms that are always booked. A daily routine that frustrates teams — despite the address.

More and more companies are doing the maths: is the prestige of the address really worth what it costs, in rent and in quality of life at work?

Mobility as the new centre of gravity

The spread of remote working has had an unexpected effect: it has redistributed teams geographically. Employees who lived 20 minutes from the Paris office have moved. They are now in Nantes, Lyon, or simply in the outer suburbs.

For those who come into the office regularly, the question is no longer “where is it?” but “how long, how, and how reliably?”

An office in Suresnes reachable in 12 minutes from Saint-Lazare is objectively more practical than an office in the 16th that takes 40 minutes from Vincennes.

What teams really look at

Actual commute time, not theoretical

Mobility apps have made employees very precise in estimating journeys. They are no longer fooled by straight-line distances or the optimistic estimates in property listings.

What they measure: door-to-door time, at rush hour, including connections. And they mentally compare that time with their own remote-working situation.

An office that adds 45 minutes of daily commuting compared with working from home is an office that will create resistance. Gradually, employees will choose remote work instead.

Multimodality as a resilience criterion

Teams also look at how resilient the transport options are. A space only reachable by RER A becomes unreachable the day the line is closed for works — which happens regularly.

The offices employees rate best are those that combine several options: metro, RER, bus, bike, car. This multimodality creates a flexibility that reduces transport-related anxiety.

The last mile

Often overlooked, the last mile between the station and the office is a real source of friction. A workspace 10 minutes’ walk from a poorly sheltered station, with no cycle lane and no Vélib nearby, loses points — even if it is technically “well served”.

The best spaces work on that last mile: secure bike parking, mobility concierge services, real-time information on available options.

The Grand Paris Express changes the rules

A historic territorial rebalancing

The Grand Paris Express is the largest transport infrastructure project in Europe. Once fully operational, it will make it possible to cross the whole of Île-de-France without going through Paris.

Villejuif to Saint-Denis in under 30 minutes. Châtillon to Roissy with no change in Paris. Areas that have been cut off until now will find themselves at the heart of an interconnected network.

For forward-thinking companies, setting up in these areas today means benefiting from current rents while getting ready for tomorrow’s accessibility.

Suresnes, Clichy, Villejuif: Work & Share’s bet

It is no coincidence that Work & Share chose these locations. Suresnes is 12 minutes from La Défense and one stop from Saint-Lazare. Clichy is directly connected to northern Paris and the routes towards Saint-Denis. Villejuif is part of the Grand Paris Express network.

These choices reflect a precise reading of the territory: areas with strong economic potential, under-served by quality flex spaces, and perfectly positioned for hybrid teams.

How to assess an office’s accessibility

Before visiting a space, ask yourself these questions:

What is the median commute time for your employees? Identify the 5 or 10 most common home postcodes in your teams. Calculate the journey from each. The average will give you a far more useful on-the-ground reality than a simple address.

How many different transport options serve the site? A single mode of transport is a weak point. Two or three means resilience.

Are there soft mobility services nearby? Self-service bikes, scooters, secure parking. These services reduce last-mile friction.

What is access like at rush hour? Some lines flow smoothly at 9 am but are packed at 8:30. Test at real times.

Conclusion

The office real estate market is going through a quiet revolution. The address is giving way to accessibility. Geographical prestige is fading in favour of actual commute time.

For business leaders and HR directors looking to retain their teams, attract talent and build a hybrid model that really works, choosing an office is strategic. And that choice is measured in minutes, not arrondissements.

Work & Share has built its network around this conviction. Accessible, well-connected spaces, in areas that make sense for today’s teams.

fieldData.chapeau: Why do growing companies choose flexible offices over a traditional lease?
fieldData.extrait: Growing companies can’t afford to be held back by their real estate. Flexible offices give them the agility they need to accelerate.

image-principale.alt: Growth without constraints: flex office, the ally of ambitious companies

fieldData.corps:
Fast-growing companies need space — often more and more of it — but they can’t afford to freeze their cash (long leases, costly fit-outs…)

Flexible offices were born to solve exactly this problem.

The traditional lease: the growth trap

Committing to 3/6/9 years when everything changes in 6 months

A standard commercial lease in France runs for 9 years, with possible exits at 3 and 6 years. It is designed for a certain stability — that of mature companies that know roughly where they will be in three years.

For a fast-growing start-up or SME, the logic is reversed. In a company that doubles its headcount every 18 months, committing to a space for 3 years means betting on an uncertain trajectory. Either you take too much space (and pay for empty square metres), or too little (and you’re cramped within 12 months).

The hidden costs of a traditional lease

Rent is only the visible part. A traditional lease involves fit-out work (often paid by the tenant), day-to-day operational management (maintenance, cleaning, security, IT), variable charges that are hard to predict, and a bank guarantee that ties up cash.

For a growing company that needs every euro to fund its development, these hidden costs are a real brake.

What flexible offices change in the equation

Flexibility as a strategic asset

In a managed space or premium coworking, the company pays for what it uses, when it needs it. It can adjust its space as it grows. It can open a branch in a new city without heavy real estate investment.

This flexibility isn’t just a financial advantage. It’s a strategic one. It frees up management bandwidth — no more dealing with a landlord, a property manager or a maintenance team. Leaders can focus on their core business.

The managed office: the solution for teams that want private space

For companies that need a space of their own — for reasons of confidentiality, identity or culture — the managed office is the right answer.

Unlike open coworking, a managed office is a private space, in the company’s colours, with its own access. But unlike a traditional lease, it comes turnkey: the work is done, the furniture is in place, the IT is connected. You can move in within a few days.

This is the model Work & Share offers its corporate clients: the privacy of your own space, the flexibility of an operator, the quality of a premium environment.

Scale without renegotiating

One of the least highlighted advantages of a managed office is the ability to scale without lengthy renegotiation. When a company needs more space, it talks to its operator and adjusts. No lease renegotiation, no traumatic move, no extra works.

This fluidity is precious in an economic environment where long-term visibility is rare.

What growing companies expect from their space

An environment that reflects their ambition

Start-ups and scale-ups recruit talent by selling them a project, a culture, a vision. A workspace that doesn’t match this message creates dissonance. The best candidates, the ones who have a choice, notice it.

A Work & Share space offers a level of design and quality that speaks the same language as these companies’ ambitions: serious, modern, professional — without being corporate in the narrow sense of the word.

Services that let you focus

Welcoming visitors, handling mail, fully equipped meeting rooms available on demand, common areas for breaks and informal moments. In a managed space, these services are included or easy to add.

For a 20-person SME without a dedicated office manager, that is a considerable gain.

A community that can create value

Even in a private space, being in a building shared with other companies creates opportunities. Partnerships, hires, joint developments. The Work & Share community, in each of its spaces, is an active network.

Conclusion

Growth isn’t measured only by revenue curves or headcount. It is also measured by a company’s ability to build without being held back by poorly calibrated constraints.

Flexible real estate isn’t a fallback for companies that can’t afford “real” offices. It is a strategic choice for those who want to stay agile and focus their resources on what creates value.

Work & Share has supported this approach from the start. And continues to do so, across our 15 spaces in Île-de-France.

fieldData.chapeau: Your next seminar in a flex space: why it makes a difference
fieldData.extrait: Holding your seminar in a flex workspace rather than a hotel changes something fundamental. What it brings and how to do it well.

image-principale.alt: Company seminars: why the venue changes everything

fieldData.corps:
Annual seminar, team building, project kick-off… These are key moments in a company’s life. Moments when the quality of the venue matters as much as the content of the programme.

And yet many companies hold them either in their own premises (often unsuitable) or in seminar hotels (often impersonal and overpriced). There is a third way that more and more companies are discovering: flex workspaces.

What’s wrong with the usual options

Your own offices: convenient but limiting

Holding a seminar in your own premises is convenient and cheap. But it creates a fundamental problem: teams stay in their usual environment, with their usual habits and usual distractions. The sense of a break — essential for people to think differently — simply isn’t there.

The seminar hotel: the all-inclusive package trap

Seminar hotels have modular rooms, screens and meal trays. It’s convenient, yes. But the atmosphere is often cold and interchangeable. Your teams could have been in any city in France — the room would have been identical.

And the budget is often much higher than expected.

What a flex space brings to your seminar

A change of scene without a complete break

A coworking space or managed office is a professional environment — not a hotel, not a wedding venue. Teams find themselves in a work setting that isn’t theirs. It creates the necessary break without being overly disorienting.

A space that breathes

Flexible office and event spaces are designed with natural light, generous volumes and social areas that make you want to sit down and talk. It’s very different from the windowless conference rooms often associated with seminars.

Flexible layouts

A large room for the plenary session in the morning. Smaller rooms for group workshops in the afternoon. A social area for breaks. This kind of modular layout is one of the advantages of well-designed flex spaces.

A professional setting that reflects your ambitions

The venue you choose sends a message to your teams. A beautiful space, designed for work and collaboration, says you take this moment seriously. That matters for the tone you want to set for the day.

How to prepare your seminar in a flex space

Visit the space beforehand — if possible at the same time of day and in the same conditions as your event. Check how modular the rooms are, the audio quality (acoustics are often overlooked), the catering options and how easy it is to get there by public transport.

Involve the space’s team in the preparation. Good operators are used to corporate events and can help you optimise the layout and the running order.

In short

A seminar venue is not a logistical detail. It is a decision that shapes the quality of discussions, the energy of the day and what participants take away. Flex spaces — designed for professional work, but generous in atmosphere and layouts — are often the best option.

fieldData.extrait: Work & Share and Ubiq: what our collaboration says about the flexible office market in Île-de-France. At Work & Share, we have chosen to surround ourselves with partners who live the market…

image-principale.alt: Ubiq and Work & Share: flexible office partners in Île-de-France

fieldData.corps:
At Work & Share, we have chosen to surround ourselves with partners who live the market as much as we do: Ubiq is one of them.

Not only because they list our spaces, but because we share the same conviction: flexible offices are not a passing trend, they are a profound transformation of how companies think about the workspace.

Photo credit: Ubiq

For several years now, this conviction has translated into concrete action. We regularly invite the Ubiq team to work from our spaces in the inner Paris suburbs, especially when new sites open. The goal: for them to experience the spaces from the inside and understand what “the Work & Share experience” means day to day, beyond a fact sheet or a sales visit.

And on our side, the Ubiqdata, their annual market barometer, helps us read trends, understand changes in demand and refine our positioning.

Here is what this collaboration teaches us.

The Ubiqdata: a detailed reading of the market

A unique flexible office observatory

Every year, Ubiq publishes the Ubiqdata, a 360° barometer of the flexible office market in France. It is an analysis built on actual transactions made through their platform, combined with a census of active spaces across the country.

To our knowledge, it is one of the most reliable and complete sources on the Paris coworking and managed office market.

What the 2025 figures tell us

A few key takeaways from the 2025 Ubiqdata worth sharing:

Flexible offices keep growing, but more selectively. The penetration rate of flexible offices in Paris reached 5.9% in 2025, up from 5.4% in 2024. Real growth, but it hides a more nuanced reality: in 2025, 153,000 m² opened and 123,000 m² closed. The market is sorting itself out.

Take-up of flexible offices exceeds 153,000 m² in Paris. A continued rise from 126,000 m² in 2023 and 149,000 m² in 2024 — at a time when demand for traditional offices is falling. Flexible offices are absorbing a growing share of real estate transactions.

More than 80% of companies leaving a flexible office choose another one. This figure is perhaps the most telling. Flexible offices are no longer a stopgap or a transitional solution. They are a deliberate, renewed choice.

Commitment periods are getting longer: over 14 months on average in 2025. After several years of contraction, companies are settling in for longer. They have found their feet in the model.

This data paints a picture of a mature market in a consolidation phase. Strong players are reinforcing their positions. Concepts without substance are disappearing. That is good news for operators who focus on the quality of their spaces and the user experience.

A collaboration that plays out on the ground

When the Ubiq team comes to work at Work & Share

There is one thing no data can replace: first-hand experience. That is why we regularly organise working days for the Ubiq team in our spaces in the inner Paris suburbs — especially when new sites open.

The idea is simple. The team settles in, works a full day, tests the tools and talks with our teams. Not a 45-minute guided tour. A real working day.

What comes out of it goes well beyond sales. These are valuable on-the-ground observations: on what works in the layout, on the real atmosphere of a space, on the day-to-day quality of services. Feedback we use to improve our offer.

What this changes in practice for our clients

Spaces designed in light of market trends

When the Ubiqdata shows that commitment periods are getting longer and that companies are looking for more stability in their flexible contracts, it shapes how we build our offers. When it shows that outlying districts are gaining ground, it feeds our thinking on future locations.

Market data doesn’t replace operational judgement, but it informs it.

Partners who know our spaces from the inside

For a company looking for an office to rent in Paris, the quality of the advice it receives depends directly on its adviser’s on-the-ground knowledge. A partner who has spent a full day working in our spaces can talk about them with a precision that neither photos nor listings can match.

That is what we are trying to build with Ubiq. And ultimately, it is what benefits the companies that join us.

Conclusion

The flexible office market in Paris is maturing. The 2025 Ubiqdata figures show it clearly: resilient demand, consolidating players, companies settling in for longer. It is a strong signal for those who have bet on quality rather than volume.

Our collaboration with Ubiq is part of this approach. Sharing a vision of the market, learning from each other’s on-the-ground observations, keeping a direct, human connection between partners.

And that is also how we keep improving what we offer our clients.

FlashOffice: who they are and how they work

An agency that specialises solely in flex office

Support that doesn’t stop at signing

When Clichy opens, the FlashOffice team will already have their own vision of the space — which is no small thing when it comes to talking about it with their clients.

Why we find this approach useful

Partners who only discover a space on opening day often leave with the same information as any other visitor. Bringing them in earlier gives them the chance to understand what we set out to build, beyond what you can see once the works are finished. It is a modest time investment on both sides, but it noticeably changes the quality of what they can then pass on to their clients.

A relationship that truly involves the teams

Exchanges at every level

What characterises our collaboration with FlashOffice is that it isn’t limited to sales exchanges. Our CEOs know each other and talk regularly — about the market, trends and what each of them is seeing. Our marketing teams share feedback on what works, practices and thoughts on the sector. And our sales teams are in frequent contact: when a lead comes in, the right people find each other quickly without having to re-explain everything each time.

This smooth way of working between our teams has a concrete impact on the quality of support we can offer together to companies looking for offices.

What this changes for companies

Advice grounded in reality

For a company looking for flexible offices in Île-de-France, what makes the difference is often the precision of the information it receives. FlashOffice can talk about Work & Share Saint-Ouen because they have been there, and they will be able to talk about Clichy because they have seen the project up close. This level of detail shows in the recommendations they make to their clients: they are tailored to the real situation, not built on generic descriptions.

The right company in the right place

The flexible office market offers many options in Île-de-France today. FlashOffice’s job is to help each company find the space that suits it — not only on obvious criteria like size or price, but also on atmosphere, possible uses and the dynamics of the place. It is work that requires in-depth knowledge of the spaces, and that is exactly what their collaboration with us is built on.

Conclusion

Our collaboration with FlashOffice has been built gradually, through visits, exchanges between teams and projects handled together. fieldData.corps:
A few weeks ago, Matthieu Russel, CEO of Work & Share, posted a series of building-site photos on LinkedIn. Partitions going up, empty spaces taking shape, an architectural building in the heart of Villejuif. The caption? “#Villejuif is taking shape. And honestly, we can’t wait.”

It’s easy to see why.

Villejuif is no longer just another suburban town. It is an area undergoing major change, connected to the Grand Paris Express, a stone’s throw from the extended line 14, a few minutes from central Paris. For companies looking to set up smartly — without paying Paris rents and without sacrificing accessibility — it is a location that is starting to make sense.

Work & Share will open a new space there in July 2026.

Villejuif: why now?

An area changing fast

For several years now, Villejuif has been attracting growing attention from real estate investors and large companies. The main reason: the Grand Paris Express.

Line 15 South, currently being rolled out, will run through Villejuif and connect the town directly to hubs such as La Défense, Saint-Denis, Roissy and Orly. In other words, a company based in Villejuif will soon be less than 30 minutes from almost the whole of the Île-de-France economy.

This is exactly the kind of calculation the savviest real estate departments are making.

A dense employment area short on flex space

The area south of Paris is home to major healthcare institutions (the Gustave Roussy site is in Villejuif itself), service companies, start-ups and growing SMEs. Until now, the supply of flexible workspaces there remained limited compared with other areas.

That is the gap Work & Share is filling.

What Work & Share Villejuif will be

A space designed for working, not just for sitting

Work & Share doesn’t build neutral offices; we have a clear approach: spaces with an identity, with attention to design, light, materials, and how teams feel when they arrive in the morning.

The building-site photos already give a glimpse: the Villejuif building is architectural. Curves, a glass façade, greenery outside. It’s no ordinary office block.

Inside, you’ll find the fundamentals of the Work & Share offer:

– Managed offices for companies that want a turnkey private space without the constraints of a traditional lease. No works, no operational management, no imposed long-term commitment.

– Coworking spaces for hybrid teams, freelancers, or companies that want to test a local presence before committing.

– Meeting rooms and event spaces for team meetings, seminars and client sessions. Modular, equipped spaces available by the half day or full day.

The operational promise

What sets a Work & Share space apart from a traditional rental is the level of service. Reception, maintenance, occupant services, community management. The goal is simple: teams shouldn’t have to worry about anything but their work.

Who is this space designed for?

Companies expanding their presence in Île-de-France

Many Paris-based organisations are now looking to the inner suburbs to open branches, bring teams closer to where they live, or simply diversify their locations. With its growing accessibility, Villejuif is becoming a serious option.

Work & Share offers them a solution that is ready to go.

Growing local companies

SMEs and mid-sized companies based in the Val-de-Marne often struggle to find quality spaces without committing to long, rigid leases. A Work & Share managed office meets this need directly: premium spaces, contractual flexibility, a professional image.

Hybrid teams

For many companies, the five-day office week is a thing of the past. But working from home every day isn’t a sustainable solution either. A quality coworking space in Villejuif is the missing link for employees living in southern Île-de-France.

Villejuif in Work & Share’s strategy

The Villejuif opening is part of a broader movement. Work & Share is present in 13 towns in Île-de-France.

The logic is consistent: cover the areas of Greater Paris that have real economic density but little quality flex supply. It’s not a race for square metres — it’s a strategy of territorial coverage, built space by space, with a constant focus on quality.

Villejuif covers the south. Other openings will complete the network.

Conclusion

Villejuif is no longer a fallback option compared with Paris. It is an area coming into its own, with real assets: developing transport infrastructure, a diverse economic fabric and more reasonable real estate costs.

Work & Share arrives with a clear proposition: quality workspaces, contractual flexibility suited to today’s companies, and a service that lets teams focus on what matters.

If you’re looking for an office in Villejuif or southern Île-de-France, the opening is coming soon. Get in touch now to be among the first occupants.

It’s exactly the kind of project that suits us. A building designed for occupants’ wellbeing, a neighbourhood being transformed by the Grand Paris Express, and a flexible offer that adapts to every profile: freelancers, SMEs, large companies.

In this article, we tell you everything Work & Share Cachan has to offer. Because choosing an office isn’t just about floor area. It’s about environment, flexibility and service.

What exactly is Arobase?

11,837 m² designed for working differently

The AROBASE building has 9 levels (ground floor + 8) with 11,837 m² of office space.

On the ground floor, you won’t just find an entrance lobby. There is an M’EAT&CO shared company restaurant (up to 410 covers a day), a VIP area, a business center with 3 meeting rooms, showers and changing rooms. In other words: everything you need to work well every day, without leaving the building.

And for those who enjoy the good weather: 673 m² of terraces, patios and balconies.

Certifications that are more than boxes to tick

Arobase is pursuing BREEAM Good certification and has energy performance 40% better than the RT2012 standard. This means genuine thermal comfort, and a CSR commitment you can highlight to your teams and clients.

Cachan: a location that changes everything

The RER B 50 metres away, and line 15 coming soon

Cachan is 4 km from Paris. Above all, Bagneux RER B station is 50 metres from Arobase. In practice, that means: 20 minutes from Gare Montparnasse, 22 minutes from La Défense, 20 minutes from Orly airport.

The future line 15 of the Grand Paris Express will also serve the area. For teams coming from all over Île-de-France, that’s hard to beat.

For those who drive, a private car park is available.

What Work & Share offers at AROBASE

A complete flexible office space on the first floor

Work & Share runs the first floor as a flexible office and event space. 1,171 m², with 221 desks in private offices, 12 hot desks, 32 standard offices, 4 meeting rooms, 3 work alcoves and 8 phone booths.

For freelancers and teams looking for maximum flexibility, the hot-desk membership starts at €160 excl. VAT/month for 10 days, up to €250 excl. VAT/month for unlimited access.

Managed offices for established teams

For teams that want their own space without the constraints of a 3-6-9 lease, Work & Share offers 3 managed offices: 14, 16 and 24 desks. Turnkey, full service, with all the building’s services included.

It’s the best option for growing SMEs, project teams setting up temporarily, or subsidiaries looking for a professional address south of Paris without overinvesting.

Who is it for?

Work & Share Cachan is designed for a wide range of profiles. Freelancers and consultants looking for a well-connected professional address south of Paris. SMEs that want to house a team in a premium setting, with flexibility on term and floor area. Large companies looking for a private space without the constraints of a traditional lease.

Conclusion

Work & Share Cachan is an address that ticks every box: a quality building, an unbeatable location in the heart of Greater Paris, services designed for teams’ comfort, and the flexibility that is too often missing from traditional commercial real estate.

Cachan has always known that “work conquers all”. Work & Share is here to help you make it your greatest asset.

fieldData.corps:
Dans un monde professionnel en constante évolution, trouver un environnement de travail qui s’adapte à vos besoins spécifiques et qui favorise votre productivité est essentiel.

C’est précisément ce que nous proposons chez Work & Share, avec notre réseau composé d’une dizaine d’espaces offrant 30.000m2 de bureaux flexibles, d’espaces de coworking et de lieux évènementiels en Île-de-France.

Work & Share en quelques mots

Work & Share, c’est avant tout une équipe dynamique de 45 collaborateurs passionnés, entièrement dédiés à créer des environnements de travail qui sont aussi uniques que les entreprises qui les occupent.

Nous avons vocation à offrir à nos clients résidents des espaces flexibles, chaleureux et conçus pour maximiser la productivité tout en favorisant le bien-être des utilisateurs.

Voici ce qui distingue Work & Share :

  • Des espaces de travail flexibles et accueillants : Les espaces sont conçus pour s’adapter à toutes les configurations, que vous soyez une petite équipe ou une entreprise de taille moyenne cherchant à se développer.
  • Des offres clé en main : Tout est pensé pour que vous puissiez vous concentrer uniquement sur votre activité. De l’accès au Wi-Fi haut débit à l’organisation d’événements, Work & Share s’occupe de tout.
  • Des prestations événementielles : Organisez vos réunions, séminaires d’entreprises, ou tout autre événement dans un cadre agréable et professionnel.
  • Une présence en Île-de-France : Avec 12 espaces stratégiquement situés à Paris, en première et deuxième couronnes, Work & Share est facilement accessible depuis le réseau de transports francilien.

Découvrez nos bureaux privatifs

Work & Share propose des bureaux privatifs qui offrent une solution idéale pour les équipes à partir de 2 collaborateurs. En optant pour ces bureaux, vous bénéficiez d’un accès 24/7 à tous nos espaces, ce qui vous permet de travailler selon votre propre emploi du temps, sans aucune restriction.

Les bureaux privatifs incluent également une série d’avantages qui font toute la différence :

  • Connexion Wi-Fi haut débit : Pour une productivité maximale sans interruption.
  • Accès aux espaces partagés : Profitez du bistrot, des salles de réunion, des espaces détente, des phonebox, ainsi que des terrasses et jardins pour vos pauses ou moments de concentration.
  • Événements d’échange mensuels : Deux événements par mois sont organisés pour encourager les échanges et le réseautage entre les résidents.

Pourquoi choisir Work & Share ?

Choisir vos bureaux chez Work & Share, c’est l’assurance de bénéficier d’un accompagnement personnalisé et d’une gamme de services de qualité.

  • Deux Coworking & Event Managers par espace : Chaque espace est géré quotidiennement par deux Coworking et Event Managers, dédiés à l’entretien de l’espace et au bien-être des résidents.
  • Une équipe commerciale dédiée : Notre équipe commerciale vous accompagne dans la recherche du bureau idéal, en fonction de vos besoins spécifiques et de vos objectifs professionnels.

Contactez Work & Share

Si vous recherchez un espace de travail qui vous offre un cadre où productivité et bien-être cohabitent harmonieusement, Work & Share est le choix parfait. L’équipe commerciale est à votre disposition pour vous guider et vous aider à trouver l’espace qui répondra à toutes vos exigences.

N’attendez plus pour révolutionner votre quotidien professionnel. Contactez Work & Share dès aujourd’hui et découvrez un environnement de travail qui vous permettra d’atteindre de nouveaux sommets.

fieldData.corps:
Work & Share est un opérateur familial indépendant, spécialiste du bureau flexible en Ile-de-France. Work & Share conçoit également des lieux événementiels à destination des entreprises et propose des services hospitaliers en pied d’immeubles de bureaux (accueil et animation, conciergerie, gestion des espaces mutualisés…).

Une aventure familiale

L’aventure Work & Share débute en 2016, en famille, lorsque Matthieu et Emmanuel Russel fondent l’entreprise en compagnie d’Adrien Le Roy, un ami d’enfance.

Les 3 co-fondateurs ont comme ambition de développer un réseau d’espaces de bureaux flexibles en première et deuxième couronnes parisiennes, dans des zones facilement accessibles en transport et dans des quartiers avec une activité tertiaire développée.

Work & Share établit son premier espace à Clichy en 2017, marquant le début d’une ambition forte : offrir des solutions de travail flexibles et compétitives pour les entreprises en Ile-de-France.

Work & Share prône une vision conviviale du coworking. À travers son concept “La maison d’hôtes des entrepreneurs”, la société développe des espaces de travail comme à la maison, en rupture avec les codes traditionnels du bureau. Work & Share crée des environnements de travail chaleureux et axés sur la communauté, où les clients peuvent collaborer, échanger et prospérer.

La société recrute des Coworking Managers, véritables hôtes de ses espaces, aux profils hôteliers, ayant un véritable attrait pour l’accueil, le service et la relation client.

Les espaces Work & Share sont conçus pour une grande diversité de professionnels : auto-entrepreneurs, freelances, petites et moyennes entreprises ou encore équipes projets de grands groupes.

L’impact de la pandémie de Covid-19

En 2020, Work & Share inaugure son deuxième espace, situé à Rueil-Malmaison au pied du RER A, dans un bâtiment indépendant de plus de 3000m2. À l’issue du premier confinement lié au Covid-19, les demandes affluent et la société décide alors d’accélérer son développement en Ile-de-France.

Le Covid-19 accélère les besoins de flexibilité et de souplesse pour les entreprises.

Progressivement, un nombre croissant de petites et moyennes entreprises font appel aux services d’opérateurs de flex office pour flexibiliser leur immobilier. Désormais, beaucoup d’entreprises font le choix de bureaux flexibles pour se rapprocher de leur lieu d’habitation et mettent en place des politiques de télétravail pour leurs collaborateurs. Les entreprises ont moins de visibilité sur leur activité et ne peuvent plus s’engager dans des baux à des durées longues et des surfaces figées. Les grands groupes utilisent également davantage les espaces de flex office pour y installer des équipes projets et externaliser la gestion immobilière.

À l’ère des nouveaux modes de travail

De 2021 à 2024, Work & Share accélère son développement avec l’ouverture de 10 nouveaux espaces en Île-de-France, situés dans le 92 et le 93.

L’année 2024 marque une étape importante pour la société, avec l’ouverture de ses deux premiers projets dans Paris intra-muros, situés dans le 12ème et dans le 18ème arrondissement.

Work & Share remporte également en 2024 l’appel d’offres pour la gestion du Business Center de l’immeuble Eos, situé à Issy-les-Moulineaux et accueillant le siège social des équipes France de Microsoft.

En parallèle, Work & Share développe une activité hospitality auprès des bailleurs pour la gestion et l’animation des halls d’immeubles et des espaces mutualisés.

À fin 2024, Work & Share a constitué un réseau d’environ 30.000m2 pour 15 espaces en Ile-de-France. La société emploie près de 50 collaborateurs.

Nos valeurs

Les valeurs de Work & Share sont profondément enracinées dans l’histoire et l’esprit des 3 co-fondateurs.

L’esprit de famille est au cœur de l’entreprise, créée par Matthieu, Emmanuel, et Adrien et qui partagent une vision commune du travail en équipe. Cet esprit familial se reflète dans leur approche de gestion, où la collaboration, la confiance, et le respect mutuel sont des piliers essentiels. Le fait que l’entreprise soit une aventure entrepreneuriale familiale lui confère une structure où chacun se sent valorisé et soutenu, tant au niveau des collaborateurs, que des clients et des autres partenaires de l’entreprise.

La bienveillance et la tolérance sont des valeurs fondamentales qui guident leur façon de gérer les relations professionnelles. Chez Work & Share, l’écoute active et l’inclusion sont des priorités. Les co-fondateurs ont créé une culture où chaque individu est traité avec respect et empathie. Cela se traduit par une forte cohésion d’équipe, une atmosphère de travail positive, et un engagement durable envers leurs clients.

Le partage est un autre pilier de Work & Share. Chez Work & Share, les collaborateurs partagent idées, connaissances, et expériences. L’entreprise se distingue par sa capacité à créer des communautés de professionnels où l’échange est encouragé. Les 3 co-fondateurs croient fermement que le succès est amplifié lorsqu’il est partagé, ce qui est au cœur de leur mission de favoriser un écosystème entrepreneurial dynamique et collaboratif.

Enfin, la convivialité est l’une des marques de fabrique de Work & Share. L’entreprise s’efforce de créer des espaces de travail chaleureux, accueillants et à taille humaine, où les interactions professionnelles se font naturellement. Leur approche unique de l’hospitalité dans les espaces de coworking et les lieux événementiels reflète une volonté de rendre l’expérience de travail aussi agréable et enrichissante que possible pour tous leurs résidents.

fieldData.corps:
Confidentialité et confort : optez pour le bureau privatif

Vous souhaitez bénéficier d’un espace entièrement dédié pour vous et votre équipe ? Notre offre de bureaux privatifs est idéale.

Vous y retrouverez des bureaux privatifs aménageables et entièrement équipés (tables, chaises, meubles de rangement). Pour faciliter votre installation, ces bureaux sont câblés, climatisés en double flux (air chaud et froid) et bénéficient d’un accès Wi-Fi très haut débit (1 Go, fibre propriétaire).

Pour une flexibilité maximale, notre espace Work & Share est accessible 24/7 et le ménage y est réalisé quotidiennement. Nous nous occupons également de la gestion de votre courrier.

La location de votre bureau privatif dans un de nos espaces de bureaux flexibles et de coworking vous donne accès à un nombre d’impressions N&B et couleurs directement inclus dans votre contrat, ainsi que d’un accès à nos salles de réunion et espaces de créativité par système de crédits.

Côté communauté, rejoindre un de nos espaces Work & Share c’est rejoindre une communauté de résidents chaleureux et bienveillants, avec qui vous aurez l’occasion d’échanger quotidiennement, notamment lors des évènements de la communauté organisés par nos Coworking Managers.

Vous les croiserez également au quotidien, dans les espaces partagés de nos espaces, auxquels vous avez tous accès : coin Bistrot, espaces de détente et de convivialité, jardins et terrasses.

Dynamisme et flexibilité : découvrez l’offre nomade

Vous êtes un travailleur indépendant et recherchez une solution de flex-office accessible dans un environnement dynamique ? Notre offre nomade est faite pour vous !

Profitez d’un poste en open space avec un accès du lundi au vendredi, de 9h à 19h.

Forfait illimité, forfait de 10 jours par mois ou achat de 10 jours de travail à consommer sur 6 mois, choisissez l’option qui convient le mieux à vos besoins professionnels.

Cette offre inclut l’accès à la Wi-Fi haut débit de l’espace, ainsi qu’à nos espaces partagés et aux différents évènements de notre communauté.

Le meilleur des deux mondes : choisissez l’offre dedicated

Un bon compromis entre l’offre nomade et le bureau entièrement privatif, nous vous proposons l’offre dedicated : un poste fixe dans un bureau fermé partagé avec d’autres membres de la communauté Work & Share.

Comme pour les contrats de bureaux privatifs, notre offre dedicated vous permet d’accéder à notre espace 24/7, et de bénéficier de trois heures de salles de réunion par mois, d’impressions incluses dans votre contrat et de profiter de nos espaces partagés et des évènements que nous organisons pour notre communauté.

Votre propre espace dans un de nos espaces : le bureau opéré

Depuis peu, nous lançons une nouvelle offre de bureaux opérés, parfaite pour les entreprises en pleine croissance, qui recherchent un espace entièrement dédié, sans les contraintes d’un bail classique.

Cette solution vous permet de disposer d’un espace de travail pouvant aller jusqu’à 300m2, comprenant une kitchenette, des bureaux privatifs et des salles de réunion, rien que pour vous et votre équipe !

Pourquoi choisir Work & Share ?

Les offres que nous vous proposons se distinguent des locations de bureaux classiques par leur caractère clé en main, sans frais supplémentaires.

Tous les services, tels que l’électricité, internet, le ménage… sont inclus dans votre contrat. En moyenne, nos clients économisent 30% par rapport à une solution en bail traditionnel.

De plus, chez Work & Share le dépôt de garantie est réduit à seulement deux mois de loyer HT, contrairement aux trois à six mois exigés par un bail classique.

Côté travaux, ne vous en souciez plus. Nos bureaux sont livrés entièrement équipés, vous permettant d’économiser entre 200 et 500€ par m2 selon les travaux habituellement nécessaires pour aménager un nouveau bureau.

En choisissant Work & Share, vous optez pour une solution flexible, économique et sur-mesure pour vous et votre équipe !

Ce nouvel espace, situé dans le bâtiment Vita au 42 rue Rouget de Lisle, est prévu pour accueillir ses premiers résidents en décembre 2024. Cette nouvelle ouverture marque une étape importante pour Work & Share, qui continue d’étendre son réseau dans les Hauts-de-Seine, offrant ainsi des solutions flexibles et modernes aux professionnels et entreprises de la région.

Un partenariat stratégique avec Ginkgo Advisor

Ce nouvel espace est développé en partenariat avec Ginkgo Advisor. Il vise à créer un environnement de travail dynamique et attrayant, avec plus de 200 postes de travail répartis sur 1 500 m². Work & Share Suresnes est conçu pour répondre aux besoins variés et en constante évolution des entreprises, qu’il s’agisse de start-ups, de PME ou de grandes entreprises cherchant à établir une présence flexible dans un cadre urbain attractif.

Un environnement de travail de haute qualité

Le bâtiment Vita, récemment restructuré, offre un cadre de travail exceptionnel avec une superficie totale de 6 350 m². L’espace est conçu pour maximiser le bien-être des utilisateurs grâce à des standards élevés de qualité environnementale. Niché en cœur de ville et à proximité des bords de la Seine, le site profite d’un environnement paisible, idéal pour favoriser la concentration et la créativité.

Les infrastructures du bâtiment comprennent notamment plusieurs terrasses, offrant un espace extérieur agréable pour les pauses ou les réunions en plein air. Le petit plus de cet espace : le rooftop végétalisé de 300 m², qui offre des vues panoramiques sur Paris et La Défense, créant ainsi un cadre inspirant et relaxant pour les utilisateurs.

Une offre de services complète

Pour répondre aux attentes des professionnels, un ensemble de services promettant une expérience client de qualité est proposé :

  • Espaces événementiels et salles de réunion, pour organiser des événements d’entreprise, des séminaires ou des réunions d’affaires.
  • Coin bistrot et frigos connectés, offrant des solutions pratiques pour les repas sur le pouce, cette installation permet aux utilisateurs de rester productifs sans quitter l’espace.
  • Douches et vestiaires, pour ceux qui souhaitent se rafraîchir après une séance de sport ou une longue journée de travail.
  • Parking pour voitures et vélos, un atout majeur pour les utilisateurs, facilitant l’accès au site.

Une stratégie de développement cohérente

Cette nouvelle implantation à Suresnes s’inscrit dans une stratégie plus large de Work & Share visant à offrir des solutions de coworking, de bureaux flexibles et d’évènementiel accessibles et de qualité en proche banlieue parisienne.

Situé à mi-chemin entre les espaces de La Défense et Saint-Cloud, l’espace Work & Share à Suresnes renforce le réseau et améliore l’accessibilité des membres Work & Share, en transports en commun ou en véhicule personnel.

Avec cette nouvelle ouverture, Work & Share atteint désormais un total de 12 espaces, couvrant une superficie de 22 500 m² et offrant environ 3 000 postes de travail. Cette expansion témoigne de l’engagement à fournir des espaces de travail flexibles et modernes, adaptés aux besoins évolutifs des entreprises d’aujourd’hui.

Pourquoi Choisir Work & Share à Suresnes ?

En choisissant le nouvel espace Work & Share à Suresnes, les entreprises bénéficient non seulement d’un cadre de travail de qualité mais aussi d’une flexibilité inégalée en termes de durée d’engagement et de surface louée. Que vous soyez une entreprise en pleine croissance cherchant à s’établir dans un nouveau marché ou une organisation bien établie à la recherche d’un environnement stimulant pour vos équipes, cette offre est conçue pour s’adapter à vos besoins.

Chez Work & Share, chaque espace possède sa propre histoire. Cependant, ils partagent tous cette âme qui fait de nos espaces de coworking, bureaux flexibles et d’évènementiel, de véritables lieux de vie.

Nous mettons un point d’honneur à ce que nos résidents se sentent comme à la maison, en créant des environnements chaleureux, où la convivialité et le bien-être sont au cœur de chaque détail.

Une ambiance chaleureuse et conviviale

Pour la décoration de nos espaces, nous optons pour des couleurs chaudes, offrant une atmosphère agréable. Nous avons à cœur d’offrir un environnement où chacun se sent à l’aise, tant pour sa journée de travail intensive que son moment de détente entre deux réunions.

Des espaces de vie pensés pour créer du lien

Tous nos espaces Work & Share sont conçus et imaginés pour favoriser les interactions et le partage.

Au cœur de nos espaces, vous retrouverez un grand Bistrot, entièrement équipé, où nos résidents se retrouvent pour déjeuner, partager un café ou simplement échanger dans un cadre informel.

Le Bistrot est comme la place du village, où notre communauté se rassemble, notamment lors des évènements communautaires que nos Coworking Managers organisent deux fois par mois.

C’est également ici que le bureau des Coworking Managers se trouve, au cœur de la communauté, ce qui renforce la proximité avec les clients.

Des espaces de détente avec des canapés confortables, livres et jeux de société sont également disséminés à différents endroits de nos espaces, offrant à chacun la possibilité de prendre une pause à n’importe quel moment de sa journée.

Des espaces de travail adaptés à tous les besoins

Nos bureaux privatifs sont conçus pour répondre aux besoins des équipes, aménagés pour accueillir de 2 à une dizaine de collaborateurs. Ces bureaux offrent un environnement calme et confortable pour les entreprises de toutes tailles, souhaitant disposer de leur propre espace de travail.

Nos espaces Work & Share disposent également tous d’un espace Nomade, parfait pour travailler au calme tout en profitant d’un cadre moins formel que le bureau traditionnel.

À chaque réunion sa solution !

Une réunion de 2 à 50 collaborateurs prévue dans les jours à venir ? Réservez dès à présent une de nos salles de réunion.

Loin des salles de réunion traditionnelles aux murs blancs, les salles de réunion Work & Share, elles aussi décorées aux couleurs chaudes et conviviales, vous garantissent le plein de productivité.

image-principale.alt: Quels sont les avantages du coworking pour les PME ?

fieldData.corps:
Longtemps associé aux startups et freelances, le coworking offre aussi de vrais atouts pour les PME.

Selon une enquête récente d’Asterès et du Think Tank du Flex Office, plus de 80 % des coworkers sont des salariés, et 75 % d’entre eux, à l’exception des indépendants, travaillent pour des PME comptant moins de 250 employés.

Cette tendance met en lumière l’importance croissante du coworking comme solution de travail pour les PME.

Flexibilité et Coûts Réduits

L’un des principaux avantages du coworking pour les PME est la flexibilité qu’il offre.

Contrairement aux baux commerciaux traditionnels, souvent rigides, le coworking permet aux entreprises d’ajuster facilement la taille de leurs bureaux en fonction de leur croissance. Par exemple, une PME en expansion peut commencer avec un petit espace et, au fur et à mesure de son développement, opter pour un bureau plus grand sans les contraintes d’un bail classique.

Chez Work & Share, les contrats de location de bureaux privatifs sont évolutifs, permettant d’ajouter des postes à tout moment si l’entreprise grandit. Cette flexibilité aide à réduire les risques financiers liés à la gestion d’un bureau classique, notamment en évitant les coûts d’exploitation liés à l’immobilier, tels que les services et l’entretien.

De plus, les résidents Work & Share règlent une seule facture qui inclut non seulement le bureau, mais aussi la connexion Wi-Fi, le ménage et l’accès aux services partagés. Cela simplifie la gestion financière et permet aux entreprises de mieux maîtriser leurs dépenses.

Attractivité et Recrutement

Dans un marché du travail compétitif, attirer des talents de qualité est essentiel pour la réussite des PME. Un espace de coworking moderne et inspirant peut jouer un rôle clé dans le processus de recrutement. Les employeurs qui proposent un cadre de travail agréable et stimulant se démarquent, ce qui leur permet de séduire des candidats potentiels.

Work & Share offre un environnement de travail qui favorise la créativité et l’innovation, avec des espaces de détente et des salles de réunion bien équipées. Cette atmosphère conviviale et chaleureuse contribue à créer un lieu où les employés se sentent bien, ce qui est crucial pour les entreprises cherchant à engager et fidéliser leurs talents.

Impact sur la Productivité et le Bien-Être

Les bénéfices du coworking ne s’arrêtent pas à l’attractivité et aux coûts. Plusieurs études ont montré que le bien-être des employés dans un espace de coworking a un impact direct sur leur productivité. D’après l’enquête d’Asterès, les gains de productivité dans ces environnements sont estimés à environ 11 000€ par an et par coworker.

Les espaces de Work & Share sont conçus pour être accueillants, avec des zones de détente et des espaces de travail collaboratifs. Cette attention portée à l’environnement de travail contribue à créer une atmosphère positive, aidant les employés à donner le meilleur d’eux-mêmes.

Opportunités de Sociabilisation et Réseautage

Un autre aspect essentiel du coworking est la possibilité de sociabilisation et de réseautage. Les espaces de coworking rassemblent des professionnels de divers secteurs, ce qui crée des opportunités d’échanges et de collaborations. Ces interactions favorisent le développement de nouvelles idées et renforcent la culture de l’innovation au sein des PME.

Chez Work & Share, la communauté de résidents compte plus de 300 entreprises de toutes tailles et de tous secteurs. Les événements organisés dans les espaces, tels que des ateliers, ou des petits-déjeuners, offrent également des occasions de rencontre. Ces moments permettent aux professionnels de partager leurs expériences, d’apprendre les uns des autres et de développer des synergies bénéfiques pour leurs entreprises.

Conclusion

En somme, le coworking représente une solution efficace et attrayante pour les PME. Il offre flexibilité, économies de coûts, et amélioration du bien-être des employés. Les espaces de Work & Share sont conçus pour répondre aux besoins variés des entreprises, en leur fournissant un cadre de travail adapté à la fois à la productivité individuelle et à la collaboration.

Si vous souhaitez en savoir plus sur les offres de coworking et de bureaux flexibles Work & Share et découvrir comment le coworking peut bénéficier à votre entreprise, n’hésitez pas à nous contacter !

fieldData.corps:
Le marché de l’immobilier de bureaux en Île-de-France a connu une évolution notable au premier trimestre 2024, avec une offre immédiate qui continue de croître, atteignant plus de 4,5 millions de m² disponibles. Cette situation sans précédent présente des dynamiques contrastées entre différents sous-marchés de la région.

Un marché à deux vitesses : Paris Intra-Muros et Neuilly vs. Couronnes Parisiennes

Deux segments distincts émergent clairement :

Paris Intra-Muros et Neuilly : Ces zones montrent une grande vitalité avec des taux de vacance extrêmement bas (2% dans le Quartier Central des Affaires, <4% à Neuilly). Le volume des transactions a augmenté de 50% entre le T1 2023 et le T1 2024, mettant en évidence une demande soutenue malgré une offre limitée. Ces marchés affichent une rapidité de rotation des biens disponibles, souvent écoulés en quelques mois.

Première et deuxième couronnes parisiennes : Ces zones, notamment la première couronne nord (Saint-Ouen, Saint-Denis, Aubervilliers, Pantin) et la zone Péri-Défense (Puteaux, Courbevoie, Nanterre, Rueil, Colombes), souffrent d’une offre excédentaire. Avec des taux de vacance élevés de 20% et 19% respectivement, ces marchés ont vu les volumes de transactions chuter, de 20% pour la Première Couronne et de 60% pour la Deuxième Couronne entre le T1 2023 et le T1 2024. La Défense elle-même, malgré une baisse du taux de vacance à 14%, continue de subir une diminution de 50% des transactions sur la même période.

La première couronne sud, comprenant des communes comme Montrouge, Ivry, Arcueil, Bagneux, et Châtillon, connaît également une hausse de la vacance, atteignant 14% au T1 2024 contre une moyenne régionale de 8%.

Ces chiffres, issus du rapport Marketbeat de Cushman & Wakefield pour le T1 2024, illustrent les défis auxquels fait face le marché immobilier de bureaux en Île-de-France.

Les bureaux flexibles : une réponse adaptée à la mutation du marché

Face à ces défis, Work & Share se positionne comme un acteur clé dans le développement de solutions de bureaux flexibles. Avec un taux d’occupation global supérieur à 85%, nous croyons fermement à la pertinence de notre modèle pour redynamiser le marché. Les bureaux flexibles offrent une réponse agile aux besoins évolutifs des entreprises, en particulier dans un contexte de marché marqué par des taux de vacance élevés et une offre excédentaire.

En collaborant étroitement avec les propriétaires immobiliers, Work & Share vise à transformer ces espaces vacants en des environnements de travail dynamiques et attractifs. Nos partenariats avec les bailleurs sont essentiels pour booster la commercialisation de leurs biens, en proposant des solutions flexibles et adaptées à une nouvelle génération de professionnels et d’entreprises.

Les avantages du coworking en période de surcapacité du marché

Les espaces de coworking et les bureaux flexibles offrent de nombreux avantages dans le contexte actuel :

Flexibilité et agilité : Les entreprises peuvent ajuster leur espace de travail en fonction de l’évolution de leurs besoins, ce qui est crucial en période d’incertitude économique.

Réduction des coûts : En optant pour des solutions flexibles, les entreprises peuvent réduire leurs dépenses en immobilisation, tout en accédant à des installations de qualité.

Stimulation de l’innovation : Les environnements de coworking favorisent les rencontres et les synergies entre professionnels de divers horizons, stimulant ainsi l’innovation et la créativité.

Amélioration de l’expérience utilisateur : Les espaces modernes et bien équipés contribuent à améliorer le bien-être des employés, un facteur clé pour attirer et retenir les talents.

L’engagement de Work & Share pour l’avenir du travail en Île-de-France

Avec une offre étendue dans les Hauts-de-Seine et au-delà, Work & Share s’engage à démocratiser le bureau flexible dans le Grand Paris. Nous sommes en discussion avec de nombreux propriétaires pour développer des espaces qui répondent aux besoins actuels des entreprises, tout en revitalisant des zones sous-utilisées.

Vous êtes propriétaire d’un immeuble de bureaux ? Ou une entreprise à la recherche d’un espace de travail flexible ? Contactez-nous pour explorer comment nous pouvons vous aider à maximiser l’utilisation de vos espaces et à offrir des solutions de travail modernes et flexibles.
